lean-draw.what: each session's sample, checked against its statement

m0-verifier.what: each session's own verdict, its roots held to its statement's and its sample checked

pins.what: each session's circuit file is the one its template's params name

negatives.what: the audit's negative controls, each a changed input the audit must refuse

registered_reads.what: each session's Lean verdict reports the registered values and roots the verifier's own file names

complete.what: no verdict of the audit's record is left unrun

round_two.what: round 2's statement check with the two-stage form allowed

outcome.what: the stream's outcome of the second stage's sample

two-stage-form.why: the two-round form's soundness is not proved

cards.note: this card's clock is held down under load, so a proving time taken on it is not a figure of the card's model
